source_text: Quadraginta octo civitates Levitis — dispersae in Israel ut doctrina ubique. Sal terrae in omnibus tribubus.
pass_a_gloss: Forty eight cities to-Levites — scattered in Israel that teaching everywhere. Salt of-earth in all tribes.
pass_b_english: [[Forty-eight cities for the Levites >> Bible:Joshua 21:41]] — scattered so teaching is everywhere. Salt of the earth in every tribe.
